params.name: object
params.description: Form object name (if * is passed) or variable reference (if * is omitted), designating the target list box, column, header, or footer.

params.name: selector
params.description: Constant (List Box theme) selecting whether value sets the minimum or maximum automatic row height.

params.name: value
params.description: Minimum or maximum row height, in the unit given by the unit parameter.

sentinelValues.meaning: Height expressed as a number of pixels (default if omitted).

overloads.semanticRole: Sets the minimum or maximum row height used in automatic row-height mode for an array or collection/entity-selection list box.

constraints: Only takes effect when the list box is in automatic row-height mode (array or collection/entity-selection list boxes); otherwise it has no effect.
